docs.summary: What a migrator gets while building a plan. Everything here is per reload.

Whether a slot declared as this type can be carried across without migrating what it holds. Stricter than [`IsInert`](#api~Prowl.Ember.TypeFacts), which describes what a type itself stores rather than what a slot of that type can be holding at runtime.
The plan for another type, so a container can ask about its element type.
